part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Travel
questions: Have you done much travelling? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think it's better to travel alone or with other people? [Why?]
Where would you like to travel in the future? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a child that you know.
points: who this child is and how often you see him or her
what he or she is like
part2.closing: and explain what you feel about this child.

topics.title: Relationships between parents and children
questions: How much time do children spend with their parents in your country? Do you think that is enough?
How important do you think spending time together is for the relationships between parents and children? Why?
Have relationships between parents and children changed in recent years? Why do you think that is?

topics.title: Children's free-time activities
questions: What are the most popular free-time activities with children today?
Do you think the free-time activities children do today are good for their health? Why is that?
How do you think children's activities will change in the future? Will this be a positive change?
